pa_deg: new reference maps + same PA affine as texture_rl
fl_mm: rank-preserving quantile map from ref FL to texture_rl FL (ordering from new model, distribution from winner)
mt_mm: ref MT * clip(rl_mt/ref_mt, 1.0, 1.08) per image, then clip to range
why: Global 0.97 on FL+MT scored 0.35218 (worse than 0.29895). Raw new-maps FL is -1.7 mm and MT -0.5 mm vs texture_rl (same wrong direction). This file keeps the new maps' PA and per-image FL ordering, restores the winning FL distribution, and applies only a bounded MT correction.
